prerequisites.title: 10 active workspace installs
prerequisites.detail: Slack requires at least 10 active installs before Marketplace submission (as of July 2026), kept through the review. Older Slack guidance said 5, so plan for 10.

prerequisites.title: Feature-complete app and test setup
prerequisites.detail: The app must be feature-complete. Prepare test accounts for each permission role, populated test data, a sample use case and a reliable security contact.

prerequisites.title: Public listing assets
prerequisites.detail: You need a listing that explains the app and links a privacy policy and support page. The support page must be reachable without an account, and the privacy policy must cover data collection, retention and deletion.

prerequisites.title: Per-workspace credentials and data isolation
prerequisites.detail: Every install gets its own tokens, and data from one workspace must never be visible in another. The install flow must work for any workspace.

steps.title: Create the Slack app
steps.detail: Create the app in your Slack developer account. Choose minimal scopes and add the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: App exists with client ID and secret.

steps.title: Draft scopes and justifications
steps.detail: List the minimum scopes needed and write a plain reason for each. Avoid admin, legacy or broad history scopes unless needed.
steps.done_when: Each scope has a written reason.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Slack auth config via Composio's API with your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Enable distribution and test install
steps.detail: Turn on OAuth distribution and install into a test workspace outside your own if possible.

steps.title: Reach 10 active installs
steps.detail: Get customers or partners to install the unlisted app and keep it active.

steps.title: Prepare submission package
steps.detail: Draft the listing copy, privacy and support page content, architecture diagram and a sample use case script.
steps.done_when: Package ready for review by you.

steps.title: Submit and provide test access
steps.detail: Submit to the Marketplace with test accounts and a security contact.

steps.title: Wait for Slack review
steps.detail: Slack runs preliminary, functional and security checks. You cannot be told when testing happens.

traps.title: Slack requires at least 10 installations on active workspaces
traps.detail: Slack requires at least 10 installations on active workspaces before a Marketplace submission (as of July 2026), and the app must stay at 10+ installs through the whole review.

traps.title: Resubmitting resets your queue place
traps.detail: Reportedly each resubmission during the preliminary review resets your place in the queue, so check listing copy before submitting.

traps.title: Broad or unjustified scopes get rejected
traps.detail: Reportedly Slack will not list apps using legacy or restricted scopes, and rejects 'nice to have' scope requests.

traps.title: Install threshold changed
traps.detail: Older guidance says 5 installs, but the July 2026 requirement is 10.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account' with the managed app, and quota is shared.

traps.title: Callback domain is visible during OAuth
traps.detail: The browser redirects through backend.composio.dev unless you proxy the callback.

blockers.symptom: Members cannot install the app in a customer workspace
blockers.what_it_means: The customer has Require App Approval turned on, so only pre-approved apps can be installed.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the customer's admin to approve the app or add it to their pre-approved list.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft an approval request describing the app and the scopes it needs.

blockers.what_it_means: Requested scopes are legacy, restricted or lack a documented use case.
blockers.what_to_do: Remove unneeded scopes or document the reason for each one, then resubmit.
blockers.agent_can_help: Audit requested scopes against features and draft justifications.

blockers.symptom: Higher-risk scope needs manual review by the customer
blockers.what_it_means: Scopes like channels:history and users:read are flagged for manual admin review in workspaces using approval rules.
blockers.what_to_do: Request only the scopes you need and explain them to customer admins.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft scope explanations for customer admins.
